name: 49436-mtplongdecode-9b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1)
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine, no router and no external cache tier
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, bounded at 500 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, 20% warmup and 10% cooldown declared, ~399 requests scored; expect roughly 6-10 minutes. Do not quote `duration`, `RPS` or `request_concurrency` off a run: the declared cooldown boundary is never reached, so all three come back pinned to the safety cap. The declared metrics are per-request statistics and are unaffected.
workload: guidellm, one synthetic_text spec, every request identical in shape: 500 prompt tokens and 5330 output tokens, both fixed, prompts distinct per request.
purpose: A long-form report writer on a 9B model, 64 concurrent users, short prompts, thousands of generated tokens, single GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
data-parallel-size: 1
language-model-only: true
# ONE LINE, DELIBERATELY: the engine reads this file line by line and skips indented ones, so
# re-flowing this mapping drops the key and starts the engine without speculative decoding.
speculative-config: {"method": "qwen3_next_mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 2}
enable-prefix-caching: true
# Pinned rather than defaulted; do not delete either as "the default".
mamba-cache-mode: align
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
# LAUNCH HAZARD: the engine core dies during startup kernel warmup with `cannot import name
# 'set_autotune_process_group' from 'flashinfer.autotuner'` unless this is false -- the pinned
# flashinfer does not export it. This model is dense bf16, so the pass tunes nothing it uses.
enable-flashinfer-autotune: false
